item.subject: science
item.stem:
For a school science exhibition, Meena's teacher asks her to choose a cell for a portable torch that students will carry around the classroom. Meena reads that a dry cell keeps its electrolyte as a moist paste rather than a free-flowing liquid, while a Voltaic cell contains a liquid electrolyte.
Which statement about the dry cell is correct?

options.A: It contains a liquid electrolyte that can spill easily, so it is best for the portable torch.
options.B: Its electrolyte is held as a moist paste, so it can be carried and used conveniently in everyday devices.
options.C: It is called dry because it contains no electrolyte at all inside it.
options.D: It must always be kept in one fixed position, so it is less convenient than a Voltaic cell.
